newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures unchanged to firm in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures unchanged to firm in quiet trade.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures closed unchanged to firmer after a day's featureless trade in limited volume, traders said.
Active May wheat last traded up 0.15 stg at 96.15 stg per tonne. Of a total wheat volume of 354 lots, 135 were on May.

Currency, the factor which has been setting the tone, made little difference, with sterling's moves in the foreign exchange markets not dramatic enough to push prices one way or the other, traders said.

Some profit taking from the buy side helped bring the nearby months up slightly, they said. They had been pleased to see interest from shippers on new crop futures, which were more mixed than the nearbys. November was the second most active month, with 80 lots traded. It last changed hands unchanged at 94.25 stg.
Market players had spent much of the day wondering whether to react to the USDA's latest statistics, but the actual effect was limited, one said.
The USDA lowered Canada's wheat export estimate to 16.0 million tonnes and raised Australia's to 14.0 million.
Barley prices eased, with active March down 0.50 stg to last trade at 92.75 stg. March traded 55 lots. Total barley volume was 97 lots.
